item.title: Ridgeland Takes Care of Rival LaFayette 42-29 - WDEF
item.description: Rossville, GA-(WDEF-TV) The Ridgeland girls basketball team rallied to beat rival LaFayette 42-29. The Panthers were down 9-4 after the first quarter, but then they held LaFayette to only one point in the second quarter thanks to their defensive pressure. Categories: Sports – Local Sports News

item.title: Heritage Downs NW Whitfield 60-45 - WDEF
item.description: Ringgold, GA-(WDEF-TV) After leading by only two at halftime, Heritage used a strong second half to beat NW Whitfield 60-45. Categories: Sports – Local Sports News

item.title: One man shot after arming himself and advancing toward officers - WDEF
item.description: BRISTOL, Tenn. (WDEF) - According to the TBI, after officers made contact with a man who was threatening self-harm, the man armed himself and reportedly advanced toward officers.

item.title: One man shot after striking an officer and stealing a police vehicle - WDEF
item.description: Hamilton County, Tenn. (WDEF) - According to the TBI, on December 28th officers encountered an individual who waved a firearm and began firing at them. James Stockwell struck one officer then stole an unoccupied police vehicle.

item.title: Police investigate shooting involving teen suffering from gunshot wound - WDEF
item.description: CHATTANOOGA, Tenn, (WDEF) - According to CPD, when officers arrived on scene, they located a 19-year-old male suffering from a non-life-threatening gunshot wound. Anyone with information is asked to contact the CPD at 423-698-2525

item.title: Brides and Grooms to be explore options at Tennessee Valley Bridal Fair - WDEF
item.description: COLLEGEDALE, Tenn. (WDEF) - News 12 hosted the annual Tennessee Valley Bridal Fair today, bringing together brides and grooms to be for a one stop wedding planning experience.

item.title: Structure fire results in total loss - WDEF
item.description: CHARLESTON, Tenn. (WDEF) - On Saturday afternoon, Bradley County Fire and Rescue says crews arrived to find the residence already fully involved. Firefighters confirm the house is a total loss, with nothing left to save.

item.title: Two-vehicle crash resulted in two adults trapped inside - WDEF
item.description: CLEVELAND, Tenn. (WDEF) - According to Bradley County EMS, multiple agencies responded to a two-vehicle crash resulting in two adults trapped inside. All individuals from both vehicles were able to walk away from the crash with no injuries.

item.title: String of auto burglaries solved after search of suspect's vehicle - WDEF
item.description: OOLTEWAH, Tenn. (WDEF) - According to the HCSO, four vehicles were entered into and multiple items were stolen. A search warrant was given for the suspect's vehicle and found stolen items and marijuana during the search.
